sloka: स भुक्त्वा फलमूलं च महर्षिं तमुवाच ह ।इयं यज्ञविभूतिस्ते कस्याश्रमसमीपतः ।। ७.६५.८ ॥
transliteration: sa bhuktvā phalamūlaṁ ca maharṣiṁ tamuvāca ha ।iyaṁ yajñavibhūtiste kasyāśramasamīpataḥ ।। 7.65.8 ॥

translations.english: After eating the fruits and roots, Shatrughna then asked the great sage about the origin of the sacrificial splendor he observed near the hermitage.
